topics.title: 一个你敬佩的人
topics.prompt: Describe a person you admire. You should say who this person is, how you know them, what qualities they have, and explain why you admire them.
sentences: The person I'd like to talk about is my grandfather, who has influenced me more than anyone else.
He spent over thirty years working as a village teacher, often walking miles to reach his students.
What I admire most is his patience — he never lost his temper, even when things went badly wrong.
He taught me that persistence matters far more than talent, and I still carry that lesson with me today.
Looking back, I realise how much of my own attitude towards work comes from simply watching him.
topics.tips: 人物题结构：是谁 → 怎么认识 → 两个品质（用具体小故事）→ 为什么敬佩（一句感悟）。

topics.title: 一个有趣的地方
topics.prompt: Describe an interesting place you have visited. You should say where it is, when you went there, what you did there, and explain why it was interesting.
sentences: The place I want to describe is a small coastal town about two hours from my city.
I went there last summer with a couple of friends, mainly to escape the noise of the city.
We spent most of our time walking along the old harbour and trying local seafood.
What made it special was the pace of life — nobody seemed to be in a hurry.
It reminded me that sometimes the best trips are the ones with no fixed plan at all.
topics.tips: 地点题结构：在哪 → 何时去 → 做了什么（2-3 个细节）→ 为什么有趣（对比日常）。

topics.title: 一次难忘的旅行
topics.prompt: Describe a trip you remember well. You should say where you went, who you went with, what happened during the trip, and explain why you remember it.
sentences: One trip that stands out is a three-day hike I did with my cousin in the mountains.
We started early in the morning and completely underestimated how steep the path would be.
Halfway up it started raining, so we sheltered in a small hut and shared our food with another group.
By the time we reached the top, the clouds had cleared and the view was absolutely worth it.
What I remember most is not the scenery but the feeling of finishing something genuinely hard.
topics.tips: 旅行题结构：去哪 → 和谁 → 发生了什么（一个小意外）→ 为什么难忘（感受）。

topics.title: 一个你喜欢的礼物
topics.prompt: Describe a gift you received that you liked. You should say what it was, who gave it to you, when you received it, and explain why you liked it.
sentences: The gift I'd like to talk about is a pair of running shoes my sister gave me two years ago.
At the time I had just started jogging, and I was using an old pair that hurt my knees.
She noticed, did some research, and picked a model that suited my running style.
What made it special wasn't the price but the fact that she had clearly paid attention.
I still wear them every weekend, and they remind me that good gifts are about thought, not money.
topics.tips: 礼物题结构：是什么 → 谁送的 → 何时 → 为什么喜欢（细节+情感）。

topics.title: 一项你学会的技能
topics.prompt: Describe a skill you learned that was difficult at first. You should say what it was, how you learned it, why it was difficult, and explain how you feel about it now.
sentences: The skill I'd like to describe is swimming, which I only learned properly in my late twenties.
As a child I was afraid of deep water, so I avoided pools whenever I could.
I finally signed up for adult lessons and practised twice a week for about three months.
The hardest part was breathing rhythm — for weeks I would panic after two strokes.
Now I swim a kilometre a week, and it has become the most relaxing part of my routine.
topics.tips: 技能题结构：是什么 → 怎么学 → 难在哪（具体细节）→ 现在感受（对比过去）。

topics.title: 一本你喜欢的书或电影
topics.prompt: Describe a book or film you enjoyed. You should say what it is, when you first read or watched it, what it is about, and explain why you enjoyed it.
sentences: The book I want to talk about is a novel called The Remains of the Day.
I first read it during a long train journey and finished it in one sitting.
It tells the story of an English butler looking back on decades of service and missed chances.
What struck me was how quietly powerful it is — the emotions are hidden between the lines.
It made me think about how people often realise what matters most far too late.
topics.tips: 书影题结构：是什么 → 何时接触 → 内容一句话 → 为什么喜欢（手法/主题）+ 一句感悟。

topics.title: 一次帮助别人的经历
topics.prompt: Describe a time you helped someone. You should say who you helped, what you did, how they reacted, and explain how you felt about it.
sentences: I'd like to talk about an evening when I helped an elderly neighbour with his phone.
He had bought a new smartphone but couldn't work out how to make video calls.
I spent about an hour setting it up and writing down simple steps in large letters.
He was genuinely grateful, and a few days later he called his granddaughter for the first time.
It was a small thing, but it reminded me how much technology can isolate people who are left behind.
topics.tips: 帮助题结构：帮谁 → 做了什么（具体步骤）→ 对方反应 → 你的感受/启发。

topics.title: 一个你常去的安静地方
topics.prompt: Describe a quiet place you like to go. You should say where it is, how often you go there, what you do there, and explain why you like it.
sentences: The place I'd like to describe is a small teahouse hidden behind an old temple near my home.
I go there roughly once a week, usually on Sunday afternoons.
I take a book, order a pot of tea, and simply read for a couple of hours.
What I like most is that the owner never plays music and nobody talks on the phone.
In a city this noisy, silence has become something you have to actively look for.
topics.tips: 安静地点题结构：在哪 → 多久去一次 → 做什么 → 为什么喜欢（氛围对比）。

topics.title: 一件你买过的重要物品
topics.prompt: Describe something important you bought. You should say what it was, where you bought it, why you bought it, and explain why it is important to you.
sentences: The item I'd like to talk about is my first proper laptop, which I bought five years ago.
I saved for almost a year and finally ordered it during a sale online.
I needed it for work, but it also became the tool I used to learn programming.
It was expensive for me at the time, which made me take care of it and use it well.
Looking back, that laptop opened the door to the career I have today.
topics.tips: 物品题结构：是什么 → 在哪买 → 为什么买 → 为什么重要（改变/意义）。

topics.title: 一个你参加过的活动或节日
topics.prompt: Describe an event or festival you attended. You should say what it was, when and where it happened, who you went with, and explain what you enjoyed about it.
sentences: The event I want to describe is a lantern festival I attended in a small town last winter.
I went with my family, and we arrived just before sunset when the streets were already crowded.
There were handmade lanterns along the river, street food stalls, and a short fireworks display.
What I enjoyed most was watching children run around trying to guess the riddles on each lantern.
It was simple and a bit chaotic, but it felt much warmer than any big commercial event.
topics.tips: 活动题结构：是什么 → 何时何地 → 和谁 → 最喜欢什么（一个具体画面）。

topics.title: 一次改变计划的经历
topics.prompt: Describe a time when your plans changed. You should say what the original plan was, why it changed, what you did instead, and explain how you felt about the change.
sentences: I'd like to talk about a weekend when a planned trip was cancelled at the last minute.
My friends and I had booked train tickets, but a sudden storm closed the line.
Instead of going home, we decided to explore our own city as if we were tourists.
We visited a museum we had never entered and tried a restaurant we'd walked past for years.
It turned out to be one of the best weekends of that year, purely because we stayed flexible.
topics.tips: 改变计划题结构：原计划 → 为什么变 → 改做了什么 → 感受（意外收获）。

topics.title: 一次克服困难的经历
topics.prompt: Describe a difficult situation you dealt with successfully. You should say what the situation was, why it was difficult, what you did, and explain what you learned from it.
sentences: The situation I'd like to describe is preparing for a professional exam while working full-time.
I had only two months, and most of my evenings were already taken up by overtime.
I started getting up an hour earlier and studied in short, focused blocks before work.
The hardest part was staying consistent when I was exhausted and tempted to skip a day.
In the end I passed, and the main lesson was that small daily progress beats occasional bursts.
topics.tips: 困难题结构：什么困难 → 为什么难 → 怎么解决（具体方法）→ 学到什么（一句总结）。
